description: Data layer + pure key helpers + live migration. Adds the ApiKey Prisma model (keyHash unique, userId index, number binding, nullable name/lastUsedAt/revokedAt, cascade relations), the idempotent @libsql/client migration script cloned from scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs, and the pure, DB-free key helpers in src/lib/api-key.ts (generateApiKey, hashKey, looksLikeApiKey, isSuperAdminUser). Foundation feature with no runtime route wiring; independent of FEAT-002/003 and must land first because they import the model types and the pure helpers.
steps: Edit prisma/schema.prisma: add the ApiKey model per design.md §1.1 — id String @id @default(cuid()); userId String + user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id], onDelete: Cascade); whatsappNumberId String + whatsappNumber WhatsAppNumber @relation(fields:[whatsappNumberId], references:[id], onDelete: Cascade); name String?; keyPrefix String; keyHash String @unique; lastUsedAt DateTime?; revokedAt DateTime?; createdAt DateTime @default(now()); updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt; @@index([userId]). Do NOT add a redundant @@index([keyHash]). Add inverse relation field `apiKeys ApiKey[]` to both the User model and the WhatsAppNumber model.

Create scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs by cloning scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs mechanics exactly: manual .env parse, createClient({url: env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL, authToken: env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN}), a single PRAGMA table_info(ApiKey) probe used ONLY to pick the log line, then run all three DDL statements unconditionally — CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ApiKey (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, userId TEXT NOT NULL, whatsappNumberId TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, keyPrefix TEXT NOT NULL, keyHash TEXT NOT NULL, lastUsedAt TEXT, revokedAt TEXT, createdAt TEXT NOT NULL, updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ApiKey_keyHash_key ON ApiKey (keyHash); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ApiKey_userId_idx ON ApiKey (userId). No FOREIGN KEY, no SQL timestamp defaults. catch -> console.error(non-secret) -> process.exit(1); client.close() in finally.

Create src/lib/api-key.ts (pure, no DB, no request) per design.md §2 and §4.4: PREFIX = "wa_live_"; generateApiKey() uses crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"), returns { plaintext: PREFIX+random, hash: hashKey(plaintext), prefix: PREFIX+random.slice(0,4) }; hashKey(plaintext) returns crypto.createHash("sha256").update(plaintext).digest("hex"); looksLikeApiKey(token) returns token.startsWith(PREFIX) && token.length >= PREFIX.length + 43; isSuperAdminUser({email, role}: {email: string; role: string}) returns email === (process.env.SUPERADMIN_EMAIL || "neanvtech@gmail.com") || role === "superadmin". Never log plaintext, hash, or random bytes.
Run node scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs against live Turso (requires TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN in .env). Run npx prisma generate so the ApiKey client types are available to later features.
acceptance_criteria: node scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs exits 0 and logs 'ApiKey table created.' on first run; a second run exits 0, logs 'ApiKey table already exists. Skipping.', and creates no duplicate (AC1).
On live Turso, PRAGMA table_info(ApiKey) lists all 10 columns and PRAGMA index_list(ApiKey) contains ApiKey_keyHash_key (unique) and ApiKey_userId_idx.
npx prisma generate succeeds and the generated client exposes model ApiKey with a unique keyHash field (AC2).

src/lib/api-key.ts compiles under the project tsconfig; hashKey is deterministic, looksLikeApiKey accepts a generateApiKey() plaintext and rejects 'bad' and 'wa_live_', and isSuperAdminUser returns true for the SUPERADMIN_EMAIL/neanvtech@gmail.com email even when role==='admin'.
verification: node scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs (run twice: first 'created', second clean no-op exit 0).
Confirm live schema via a throwaway @libsql/client snippet running PRAGMA table_info(ApiKey) and PRAGMA index_list(ApiKey); delete the throwaway after.
npx prisma generate && npm run build must pass (prisma generate picks up ApiKey; next build type-checks src/lib/api-key.ts).
Optional one-shot node sanity check that hashKey(generateApiKey().plaintext) equals that call's hash and looksLikeApiKey behaves; remove any throwaway after.
findings:
COMPLETED. Live Turso WAS reachable in this environment; migration ran against it successfully.

--- ApiKey model (prisma/schema.prisma) exact field names/types ---
id String @id @default(cuid()); userId String + user User @relation(onDelete: Cascade); whatsappNumberId String + whatsappNumber WhatsAppNumber @relation(onDelete: Cascade) (immutable binding, no update endpoint); name String? (nullable at DB; API layer owns the 'required' rule); keyPrefix String (non-secret display fragment e.g. 'wa_live_ab12'); keyHash String @unique (SHA-256 hex); lastUsedAt DateTime?; revokedAt DateTime?; createdAt DateTime @default(now()); updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt; @@index([userId]). Inverse relation field 'apiKeys ApiKey[]' added to BOTH User and WhatsAppNumber. No standalone @@index([keyHash]).

--- Live Turso schema (verified via throwaway PRAGMA snippet, now deleted) ---
Columns (10): id, userId, whatsappNumberId, name, keyPrefix, keyHash, lastUsedAt, revokedAt, createdAt, updatedAt. Indexes: ApiKey_keyHash_key (unique=1), ApiKey_userId_idx (unique=0), plus sqlite_autoindex_ApiKey_1 (implicit PK). Index names match Prisma convention exactly. Migration run twice: first logged 'ApiKey table created.' (exit 0), second logged 'ApiKey table already exists. Skipping.' (exit 0, clean no-op).

--- Helper signatures (src/lib/api-key.ts, pure, no DB) ---
const PREFIX = "wa_live_";
generateApiKey(): { plaintext: string; hash: string; prefix: string }  // plaintext = PREFIX + base64url(randomBytes(32)); prefix = PREFIX + first 4 random chars (len 12); plaintext len 51.
hashKey(plaintext: string): string  // crypto.createHash('sha256').update(plaintext).digest('hex'); deterministic.
looksLikeApiKey(token: string): boolean  // token.startsWith(PREFIX) && token.length >= PREFIX.length + 43 (i.e. >= 51); shape gate only, SHA-256 lookup is the real gate.
isSuperAdminUser(user: { email: string; role: string }): boolean  // email === (process.env.SUPERADMIN_EMAIL || 'neanvtech@gmail.com') || role === 'superadmin'. Returns true for superadmin email even when role==='admin'.

--- Verification ---
Sanity-checked all four helpers (hash deterministic, looksLikeApiKey accepts a generated key and rejects 'bad'/'wa_live_', isSuperAdminUser true for superadmin email with role 'admin'). npx prisma generate + next build (npm run build) PASSED — ApiKey client types available for FEAT-002/003. grep of src for 'wa_live_|keyHash' shows only the PREFIX constant and the schema @unique field; no secret is ever logged. npm run lint timed out in this environment (next lint hung) but next build already type-checks and lints; no new lint-relevant code smells introduced. Throwaway schema-check snippet removed; scripts/add-api-key-table.mjs KEPT. No prisma db push run. Committed on main; NOT pushed.
